benefits.titleZh: 用完物品後把它們整齊收好
benefits.titleEn: Put things back neatly after using them
benefits.zh: tidy something away 可以用來描述把書本、玩具、工具和其他物品放回正確位置。
benefits.en: Tidy something away helps you describe putting books, toys, tools and other items back in the correct place.

benefits.titleZh: 談論整理日常生活中的地方
benefits.titleEn: Talk about making everyday places neat
benefits.zh: tidy up 適合用來談論收拾睡房、廚房、課室和共用空間。
benefits.en: Tidy up is useful when talking about cleaning and organising bedrooms, kitchens, classrooms and shared spaces.

benefits.titleEn: Describe getting ready to meet other people
benefits.zh: tidy yourself up 和 tidy somebody up 可以描述清潔身體、整理衣服或頭髮，使自己或他人看起來整潔。
benefits.en: Tidy yourself up and tidy somebody up can describe washing, fixing clothes or hair, and making someone look neat.

benefits.titleZh: 改善學校或工作上的資料
benefits.zh: tidy something up 可以表示把筆記、報告、投影片和計劃整理得更清楚、更有條理。
benefits.en: Tidy something up can describe making notes, reports, slides and plans clearer and better organised.
